name: GC AI
tagline: An AI platform for in-house legal teams whose Research Agent runs parallel, cross-checked research across 13M+ US case law opinions, statutes and regulations.
verdict: GC AI is the one research agent in this category built for a specific, high-stakes body of knowledge, US case law, statutes, regulations and agency guidance, that none of Perplexity, Manus, Elicit or GPT Researcher touch. Its Research Agent is genuinely multi-agent: specialized agents search in parallel across jurisdictions and courts, then get cross-checked and reconciled into one cited analysis, backed by real scale ($555M valuation, $73M raised) and real self-serve pricing rather than a fully sales-gated product. The honest caveats: on the cheapest plan, case-law research itself is a paid add-on rather than included; the API is private-beta and account-rep gated; and independent reviews report a thin verified-review trail relative to GC AI's own claimed customer count. Pick GC AI if your research is specifically legal and your budget is an in-house team's, not an individual's; skip it for open-web, academic or free/self-hosted research.
